---
title: "M2 - Standalone Module"
---

## Purpose

This standalone version demonstrates the capabilities of Module M2 - Video Anonymization in an isolated and reproducible setup.

## What This Demo Covers

- Standalone execution of the anonymization component
- Policy-based anonymization behavior
- Validation-oriented usage for technical demonstrations

## Technical Scope

The standalone module supports:

- Reusable anonymization workflows for business scenarios
- Configurable policies for anonymization behavior
- Admin-level configuration through no-code interaction patterns
- Integration readiness for composable architectures

## Prerequisites

Before running the demo, ensure the following:

1. Runtime dependencies are installed.
2. Input video data is available locally.
3. Output storage path is writable.

## Expected Outcome

The standalone run produces anonymized video output according to the selected policy profile, supporting functional validation and integration testing.
